text:
maya: Heads-up: rolling out 2026.03.21 canary in eu-west during the 22:00 change window. Plan is staged FF ramp for new routing.
alex: copying — what's the initial cohort size?
maya: start 5% -> 25% -> 75% over 30/30/60 mins if metrics stable :eyes:
ryan: SLOs to watch: p50 latency, error-rate, and token-cost chg. If p95 latency > 250ms or errors > 1.5x baseline -> abort + rollback.
samira: noted. release notes updated with model pin 2026-03-21-v2.0 and migration caveats.
maya: deploying now. deploy-bot: please pin canary group to v2.0 and set feature_flag 'new-routing' to 5%.
deploy-bot: @maya Command accepted: set_flag new-routing=5% target=canary group=eu-west by=maya
alex: am running a quick smoke: sending 100 requests to canary
alex: logs look ok so far, no 5xx, p95 ~120ms
deploy-bot: telemetry: 5% traffic routed to v2.0, error-rate 0.3% (baseline 0.25%), p95 latency +8% 
ryan: hold for 10m, watching heatmap and instance CPU. If CPU > 70% on any node, we stop ramp.
maya: after 30m, ramp to 25% if metrics stable. If we see a <5% delta on correctness evals, proceed.
samira: eval set prod-smoke passed at 5% — good to ramp
maya: ramping to 25% now
deploy-bot: Command accepted: set_flag new-routing=25% target=canary group=eu-west by=maya
deploy-bot: telemetry update: 25% traffic to v2.0, errors 0.4%, p95 135ms
alex: small spike in tail tokens cost, watching token utilization cache hit-rate
ryan: Implementing rollback trigger: error-rate > 1.2% OR sustained p95 > 250ms for 10m -> automatic hold and notify eng-oncall
maya: noted. manual rollback steps in thread: 1) set_flag new-routing=0% 2) pin traffic to v1.9 3) revert rollout in deploy panel
alex: 👍 I'll stay on standby. If anything strange, i'll post logs/snippets here.
maya: thanks team. I'll post final confirmation when we reach 75% or if we stop early.
